articles.title: Chinese AI company Zhipu claims its new model is a better bug-finder than Anthropic, OpenAI
articles.summary: Chinese company Zhipu launched its new AI model, GLM-5.3, claiming its bug-finding powers match leading American models. This development showcases China's rapid advancements in artificial intelligence, highlighting its global competitiveness. For SSB aspirants, this signifies the growing strategic importance of AI in national technology and defence capabilities.

articles.title: Newlyweds Emma Roberts and Cody John step out in LA in first sighting since their Idaho nuptials
articles.summary: Actors Emma Roberts and Cody John, recently married at his family's Sun Valley estate, made their first public appearance as newlyweds. They were spotted in Los Angeles, California, on Sunday, enjoying ice cream. This sighting confirms their marital status, marking their initial outing since tying the knot and drawing public attention.

articles.title: ‘Spearhead of annexation’: Israel hands West Bank rule to civilian police
articles.summary: Palestinian politicians and analysts have warned against an alleged Israeli plan to illegally annex the West Bank. They claim Israel is implementing a series of decisions and actions to achieve this goal, which they deem a violation of international law. This potential annexation raises significant concerns for regional stability and the future of the Israeli-Palestinian conflict.
